convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator (XDPOCandle) with external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing and trade execution. Custom indicator buffer logic cannot be replicated with built-in indicators alone.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds for signal time calculation
min_rates_total - minimum bars required before indicator is ready

other_exits: Signal-based close: BUY_Close triggered when XDPOCandle color changes to 0 (bearish), SELL_Close triggered when XDPOCandle color changes to 2 (bullish)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM=0.1 with MMMode=LOT means fraction of deposit; MMMode enum (LOT, RISK) determines interpretation - positive=fraction of deposit when MMMode=LOT

custom_logic_notes: The EA reads XDPOCandle indicator buffer 4 which returns color values (0=bearish, 2=bullish, 1=neutral). Entry requires a color change: Col[1]==2 (current bar bullish) AND Col[0]!=2 (previous bar not bullish) triggers BUY_Open. Col[1]==0 (current bar bearish) AND Col[0]!=0 (previous bar not bearish) triggers SELL_Open. This is a color-change/candle-direction reversal system. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose boolean inputs act as feature toggles. SignalBar input (default=1) controls which bar is used for signal evaluation. When SignalBar=0, signals are recalculated every tick (intraday mode); otherwise only on new bar. Recount flag forces recalculation if CopyBuffer fails.
python_conversion_notes: The XDPOCandle custom indicator must be reverse-engineered or ported first - it implements a double-smoothed detrended price oscillator displayed as candles. The smoothing algorithms (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh are non-standard and must be ported. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose which handle position management, lot sizing, and order execution - these must be reimplemented. The color-change logic (buffer 4 values 0/2) is the core signal mechanism. SL/TP of 1000/2000 pips suggest these are in points not pips - verify digit adjustment for 5-digit brokers. SignalBar=1 means using previous completed bar for signals (safe for backtesting).
